entries.name: INS8250 UART
entries.description: Asynchronous serial transmitter and receiver with a baud rate divisor and line, modem and interrupt control. The 16450 and 16550 are compatible successors; the 16550 adds FIFOs.
entries.behaviour: Eight registers selected by the low three address bits. The divisor latch bit of the line control register swaps the first two for the baud rate divisor. The original 8250 has no scratch register.
